title: Melon and Stir-Fry Delight
description: A refreshing and flavorful Thai-inspired dish that combines the sweetness of melon with the savory flavors of a stir-fry. Perfect for a light lunch or dinner.
instructions: Heat the oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the curry paste and stir-fry until fragrant.
Add the garlic and stir-fry for 1 minute.
Add the melon and stir-fry until slightly tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Garnish with additional melon slices if desired.
